skills.name: Closing tabs
skills.description: Use when the user asks to close browser tabs, clean up Chrome tabs, or clear tab clutter on the assistant computer.
skills.content:
---
name: Closing tabs
description: >-
  Use when the user asks to close browser tabs, clean up Chrome tabs, or clear
  tab clutter on the assistant computer.
---
# Closing tabs

## Goal
Reduce Chrome tab clutter on the assistant computer by closing excess tabs while keeping useful ones open.

## Assumptions
- Work on the assistant computer (shared agent desktop), signed-in Chrome profile already in use.
- Prefer the active/current Chrome window that is already open.
- Do not close the whole browser window unless the user asks to quit Chrome.
- No credentials are involved.

## Inputs
- `{keep}` (optional): tabs or sites to keep open (e.g. keep mail, keep current tab, specific URLs). Default: keep the currently active tab (and any pinned tabs).
- `{scope}` (optional): `extras` (default — close background/duplicate clutter) or `all except keep` (close everything not in `{keep}`).

## Steps
1. Open or focus Chrome. Note the active tab title/URL and roughly how many tabs are open.
2. Resolve `{keep}`: if the user did not specify, keep the active tab and any clearly pinned tabs.
3. Close tabs that are not in `{keep}`:
   - Prefer clicking each tab’s × close control on the tab bar, working from one side of the tab strip so remaining tabs shift into place.
   - Keyboard alternative when reliable: close the focused tab with Ctrl+W, but only after switching to a tab that should be closed — never Ctrl+W on a tab meant to stay open.
4. Be careful with focus changes: closing the active tab switches the visible page; always re-check which tab is active before the next close so you do not accidentally close a `{keep}` tab.
5. Stop when only `{keep}` tabs remain (or when the requested cleanup is done). Do not close pinned tabs unless explicitly asked.
6. Report back briefly: how many tabs closed, which tab(s) remain active/open.

## Do not
- Do not clear browsing history, cookies, or sign out.
- Do not close other apps or desktop windows.
- Do not navigate away from kept tabs to “finish” the cleanup.

## Report
Short confirmation: closed N tabs; left open: {titles/URLs}.

# Zoho Mail: e-mail verplaatsen naar map

## Goal
In Zoho Mail EU (`mail.zoho.eu`, signed in as the user’s account), move one or more emails into a chosen folder.

## Assumptions
- Work on the assistant computer in Chrome, Zoho Mail already signed in.
- Destination folder `{folder}` already exists under MAPPEN. If missing, create it first (exact name the user gives).

## Inputs
- `{emails}`: which message(s)/threads to move (subject, sender, domain filter, or “selected / current”).
- `{folder}`: destination folder name.

## Sources to check (required)
Always look in all of these before declaring done:
1. Postvak IN (Inbox)
2. Notification
3. Newsletter
4. Plus top search across mail so nothing is missed in other folders

Do not stop after Inbox only.

## Steps
1. Open https://mail.zoho.eu and wait until the mail UI loads.
2. Locate `{emails}` in Inbox → Notification → Newsletter, and via search when filtering by sender/domain.
3. Select the email(s) via the avatar/checkbox so the toolbar shows selection.
4. Click Verplaatsen naar in the top action bar.
5. In the dropdown, click `{folder}`.
6. Confirm success via the toast. The item should leave the current list.
7. Repeat until no matching `{emails}` remain in those sources.
8. Report briefly: what moved → which folder; which source folders were checked.

## Notes
- Prefer checkbox → Verplaatsen naar → folder. Drag-and-drop is an optional fallback.
- Do not delete mail.
- Do not use Gmail for this workflow.

## Report
Moved: {subjects/senders} → `{folder}` (count). Checked: Inbox, Notification, Newsletter (+ search).

# Sollicitatie: CV altijd meesturen

## When
Any time the user asks to draft, fill in, or send a job application, open sollicitatie, kennismakingsmail naar een werkgever/recruiter, or similar hiring outreach.

## Required step (non-negotiable)
Always attach the user’s current CV before the message goes out — never send a sollicitatie email “text only” and promise the CV later unless they explicitly say to skip the attachment.

## CV location
Use the durable CV file the user designated for this assistant (store it under the agent’s files folder). Filename for the attachment should match that file.

If the path is missing, stop and ask for the updated CV — do not send without it.

## Steps
1. Draft or confirm the sollicitatie text as usual (show draft first when the user prefers review).
2. Before send / form submit: attach the CV (browser upload / Zoho Mail attachment flow as needed).
3. In the email body, keep a short line that the CV is attached.
4. Confirm: sent + CV attached (yes/no).

## Do not
- Do not forget the attachment “to follow up later.”
- Do not use a random old attachment from Downloads if the durable CV file exists.
- Do not share the CV outside sollicitatie / hiring contexts unless the user asks.

# Xbox Player Voice feedback

## Goal
Help the user draft and submit game/Xbox feedback through Microsoft’s official Player Voice portal, not through unofficial email or social DMs.

## Official channels
- Ideas / experience feedback: https://aka.ms/XBOXplayervoice (Xbox Player Voice).
- Bugs / Insider previews: Xbox Insider Hub, or console Report a problem. On Windows, Feedback Hub for PC issues.
- Account / billing help: Xbox Support, not Player Voice.

## Steps
1. Confirm the game or Xbox feature, platform (console / PC / cloud), and whether this is an idea, a bug, or a support issue. Route support issues to Xbox Support instead of Player Voice.
2. Draft a clear title and body: what happened or what they want, expected vs actual, repro steps if a bug, Game Pass vs retail, console generation if relevant.
3. Show the draft and get an explicit yes before submitting (posting as the user is consequential).
4. There is no Xbox MCP connector. Submit in the browser at https://aka.ms/XBOXplayervoice. If Microsoft sign-in is required, hand over for login (never ask for a password). After they hand back, complete the form and report the confirmation.
5. Tell the user they can also track status in Player Voice after submit.
